versions.overlap: v52의 52개 항목은 모두 v65에 포함. v65 추가 13개: PHY-13, COG-08, COG-09, COG-10, BEH-15, BEH-16, BEH-17, BEH-18, BEH-19, BEH-20, BEH-21, BEH-22, NUR-10
